prompts.icon:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready transparent sprite atlas for a cozy food travel game called Alphabet City.
Primary request: a small pixel-art passport inventory button with SIX hover animation keyframes in ONE sheet.
Output: landscape PNG, exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels, genuine transparent alpha background. Strict 3 columns by 2 rows, each cell exactly 512 by 512 pixels. NO grid lines, labels, frame numbers or backdrop.
Subject: the SAME pocket passport in every frame, deep forest-green cloth cover (#304a36, lighter #506647), warm gold embossed globe emblem and two short gold rules, cream page edges, dark brown-black 1-pixel-style outline. No letters or readable text. Rounded corners made from square pixel steps. Slight elevated three-quarter view, spine on the left, clearly a travel passport rather than a generic notebook. Chunky polished 16-bit RPG pixel art, about 48 by 64 logical pixels for the book, nearest-neighbor enlarged, hard square pixel clusters, limited palette, 3 shades per material, no smooth vector gradients. Matches warm cream, olive green and gold retro game UI and pixel food stickers.
Frame order left to right, then top to bottom:
0: closed passport at rest, upright, no sparkle.
1: identical closed passport lifted very slightly, tilt counterclockwise by a tiny angle.
2: lifted slightly more, front cover beginning to open, cream pages peeking from right.
3: cover opening to about 35 degrees, more cream inside visible, same spine and scale, one small gold four-point pixel sparkle near upper right.
4: cover opened to about 65 degrees, blank pale interior, green back cover still obvious, two tiny gold four-point pixel sparkles near upper right, widest pose.
5: same opened passport as frame 4, settled very slightly, sparkle moved a few pixels for a twinkle. This frame will play with the preceding ones in reverse to close.
Geometry: each book's spine/hinge is anchored at the same relative point (220, 278) within its 512px cell, all identical scale. All art, including sparkles, stays inside central 380 by 400 pixels of EACH cell, with generous transparent gutters on all sides. Keep opening poses inside their own cells. No ground shadows, no hands, no extra objects, no border or halo, no checkerboard. True transparent background essential.
prompts.left:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: LEFT passport interior page background for a digital food-collecting passport in a cozy retro travel game.
Create ONE finished portrait page texture, 1024 by 1536 pixels, filling the entire rectangular canvas edge to edge. Flat straight-on orthographic UI texture, no perspective, no room, desk, hands or photographed mockup. This is the left half of an open passport: outer page edge on the LEFT, subtle binding fold at the RIGHT edge.
Style: softly detailed real passport security paper reinterpreted as polished 16-bit pixel art. Visible tiny square pixel clusters, restrained dither, warm ivory base (#f4ecd5 and #fbf6e6), very pale sage mint and muted tan ink. Subtle paper fibers, faint interlaced guilloche curves and rosettes near margins, delicate pale green ornamental border inset 36 pixels, extremely faint globe/world-map watermark centered behind the page. Passport paper, not torn parchment or a fantasy scroll. A narrow dark forest-green cover sliver at the far left edge, slim ochre paper edge, rounded outer corners built from small stepped pixels. Gentle narrow gutter shadow confined to the rightmost 50px. Paper is clean and lightly handled, no heavy stains.
Usable content area: middle 80 percent of page should remain very pale and calm so colorful collected pixel dish stickers and their names can be placed over it. Paper pattern low contrast, around 5 to 9 percent. No pre-drawn collection boxes or slots, no stamps, no photographs, no food, no characters, no flags, no labels, no page numbers, no text, no readable document details. No modern shiny effects or strong highlights. Render an actual complete usable page asset rather than a UI screenshot.

transparencyRefinement:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: this existing SIX-frame passport sprite atlas. Keep all six book and sparkle sprites in exactly the same positions, same 1536x1024 canvas, 3 columns by 2 rows of 512x512 cells, same art, colors, poses, outlines, dimensions, green covers, gold globes and cream pages.
Change ONLY the unwanted background haze and transparency. Remove all the dark brown/green radial haze and diffuse glows around each book. Every pixel outside the actual crisp passport silhouette or crisp four-point gold sparkles must be FULLY TRANSPARENT (alpha exactly zero). Book interiors, green covers, outlines, cream pages and the small crisp sparkle shapes must be opaque, not semitransparent. Preserve tiny cutouts between open pages as transparent. Keep square pixel edges.
The resulting PNG must be a clean production sprite sheet on genuine transparent alpha with no shadow, halo, vignette, glow, checkerboard or background fill. Do not redesign, reposition, recrop, resize, add or remove any sprite. Do not change the cream inside the open books. This is a transparency cleanup only.
